title: Availability
description: Sellable capacity of every rentable product for a pick-up / return branch, a date range and a sales channel. A vehicle only counts when it can cover the whole range without a gap.
forbidden: You are not allowed to search availability.
results_summary: {{pickup}} → {{return}} · after the return and its preparation the vehicle is sellable again from {{ready}} ({{prep}} min).
results_empty_description: No published, active rentable product was found.
start_description: Pick a pick-up branch, a date range and a channel, then press "Search". A search consumes no capacity.
fields.channel_hint: Channel rules (quota, limit, safety margin) are applied for this channel.
fields.hold_minutes_hint: The hold lapses on its own after this time and frees the capacity (at most 1440).
fields.extend_minutes_hint: New end of the hold: now + this time.
validation.ends_after_start: The return must be after the pick-up
reason.one_way_not_allowed: One-way is not allowed on this route
reason.no_eligible_vehicle: No vehicle keeps the product's guarantee
capacity_reason.no_vehicle: No vehicle can cover the whole range any more (it may have been sold meanwhile).
capacity_reason.no_eligible_vehicle: No vehicle keeps the product's guarantee.
capacity_reason.one_way_not_allowed: One-way rentals are not allowed on this route.
capacity_reason.channel_rules: The channel rules (quota, limit or safety margin) do not allow this sale.
capacity_reason.product_not_sellable: The product is not published or not active.
hold_dialog.title: Put on hold
hold_dialog.description: Reserves a vehicle for the selected range for a limited time. The plate is provisional: until the reservation is confirmed the system may move it to another eligible vehicle when needed.
extend_dialog.title: Extend hold
extend_dialog.description: Moves the end of an unexpired hold. The capacity is already held, so nothing is re-planned.
release_dialog.title: Release hold
release_dialog.description: The hold on {{plate}} for {{product}} is released and the capacity is freed.
holds.title: Active holds
holds.empty_description: Holds stay here until they lapse or are released.
toast.hold_failed: The hold could not be placed.
toast.release_affected: {{count}} record(s) could not be re-planned; check the calendar.
rule_type.sales_limit_hint: The channel may sell at most this many units of the product at the same time. Reserves nothing.
rule_type.guaranteed_quota_hint: This many units are kept for the channel; while unused, other channels cannot take them. Quotas together never exceed the real capacity.
rule_type.safety_margin_hint: This many units are never sold (for every channel when no channel is selected).
rules.title: Channel capacity rules
rules.description: Without rules every channel sells from the shared pool. Safety margins, guaranteed quotas and sales limits narrow what a channel may sell.
rules.forbidden: You are not allowed to view channel capacity rules.
rules.empty_description: Every channel sells from the shared pool.
rules.fields.product_hint: Every product: the rule applies to each product separately.
rules.fields.branch_hint: Every branch needs access to all branches.
rules.validation.channel: Sales limits and quotas belong to a channel
rules.drawer.description: One rule per type, channel, product and branch.
